answer.text: Interest payment as % of face value

explanation.text: The Logic: The coupon is the fixed promised percentage that is applied on the face value of the bond. Coupon yield is defined as coupon payment divided by face value. The Trap: Face value is the principal; current price is the market price; YTM is the implied return that discounts future cash flows to the market price. None of these is the coupon itself. Note: Coupon is contractual and fixed at issue; market price and YTM move with interest rates.
